observation.visible_scene: A white surface holds six teardrop/heart-shaped foam pieces arranged in a 2x3 grid. Top row left-to-right: red, green, purple. Bottom row: magenta/pink, blue, dark brown. Each piece is already split into two mirror halves with a vertical gap between them. A black knife blade is the only moving object.
visible_changes: From frame 1 to about frame 24 the knife blade stands roughly vertically along the cut line of the brown (bottom-right) piece, its pointed tip near the top of that piece; the brown halves keep their existing gap with no clear further separation.
Around frames 25-26 the blade withdraws to the right and leaves the brown piece, which then sits uncut-looking with its two halves in place.
At frame 27 a small blade tip re-enters at the top-left corner of the frame; by frames 28-29 the blade is angled diagonally over the red (top-left) piece.

From frame 29 to frame 41 the blade stays pressed against the red piece, its tip contacting the left half near the central cut, with only minor positional jitter; the red halves show no large change in gap.
The green, purple, magenta and blue pieces remain stationary and unchanged throughout the excerpt.
outside_clip_unknowns: Who or what holds and moves the knife is not visible.
Whether the brown piece was actively being cut before the clip or was already split is unknown.
The final result of the blade on the red piece (whether it separates the halves further) is not shown, as the clip ends mid-interaction.
uncertain_details: The blade's motion over the brown piece is very small, so it is unclear whether it is descending through the cut or simply resting along it.
Any slight widening of the red halves' gap under the blade tip is ambiguous.
No background feature moves, so camera motion appears absent but cannot be fully confirmed.
